<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Sih's Space ✦ Gryffindor</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;0,700;1,500&display=swap');
:root{--wine:#4c1019;--wine2:#21070d;--gold:#e8b83e;--gold2:#ffe9a4;--cream:#fff0c8;--muted:#b8a477;--panel:rgba(18,5,9,.88)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;color:var(--cream);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;background:#100307;overflow-x:hidden}
body:before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-2;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,#54141c 0%,#24070e 42%,#090205 100%)}
body:after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;opacity:.18;pointer-events:none;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 180 180' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.8' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.3'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}
.ambient{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;overflow:hidden}
.star{position:absolute;width:3px;height:3px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffd86b;box-shadow:0 0 10px 2px #d99b32;animation:twinkle 3s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes twinkle{0%,100%{opacity:.2;transform:scale(.7)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.35)}}
.wrap{width:min(1080px,calc(100% - 28px));margin:24px auto;position:relative;z-index:1;border:1px solid rgba(232,184,62,.65);border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(20,4,9,.9);box-shadow:0 20px 90px #0009,0 0 35px #8d1b251c}
.topbar{height:42px;padding:0 25px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:#100307;border-bottom:1px solid #6f451b7a;font:600 11px 'Cinzel',serif;letter-spacing:1.2px;color:var(--gold)}
.topbar .brand{color:var(--gold2)}.house{border:1px solid #70420d;border-radius:30px;padding:7px 13px;background:#260a0d}
.hero{min-height:245px;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;padding:38px 42px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#741c25d9,#4c1019e8 48%,#21070df5),radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 80%,#c24c2a 0,transparent 45%);border-bottom:1px solid #8e651e}
.hero:before{content:"✦";position:absolute;left:38px;top:26px;font-size:100px;color:#f5c65b;opacity:.09;text-shadow:0 0 30px #e8b83e}
.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 0 48%,#ffffff04 48% 49%,transparent 49% 100%);pointer-events:none}
.hero-copy{max-width:680px;text-align:right;position:relative;z-index:1}
.eyebrow{font:600 12px 'Cinzel',serif;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase}
.quote{font:700 clamp(23px,3.2vw,37px)/1.35 'Playfair Display',serif;text-transform:uppercase;margin:15px 0 12px;color:#fff0c6;text-shadow:0 2px 18px #f4c65b2b}
.quote-author{font:italic 15px 'Playfair Display',serif;color:var(--gold)}
.content{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.08fr .92fr;gap:30px;padding:30px 32px 34px}
.profile{min-width:0}
.profile-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:17px;margin-top:-78px;position:relative;z-index:2;margin-bottom:22px}
.avatar{width:130px;height:130px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--gold);padding:5px;background:#21070d;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #2a0b0f,0 0 30px #e8b83e2c;display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0}
.avatar-inner{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,#9e3940,#3b0c17 70%);font-size:56px;overflow:hidden}
.avatar-inner span{filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 5px #0008)}
.online{margin-bottom:7px;border:1px solid #674514;border-radius:30px;padding:8px 13px;color:#f1d58b;font-size:12px;background:#120509;white-space:nowrap}
.online i{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#62c99b;margin-right:7px;box-shadow:0 0 9px #62c99b}
.welcome{font:600 12px 'Cinzel',serif;letter-spacing:1.6px;color:var(--gold);margin:0 0 9px}
h1{font:700 clamp(38px,5vw,48px)/1 'Playfair Display',serif;margin:0;color:#fff0ce;letter-spacing:.5px}
.crown{font-size:25px;color:var(--gold);vertical-align:middle;text-shadow:0 0 15px #e8b83e75}
.handle{font:600 12px 'Cinzel',serif;color:#bda35c;margin:13px 0 17px;letter-spacing:.4px}
.bio{font:italic 16px/1.7 'Playfair Display',serif;color:#d8c8a6;margin:0 0 19px}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;margin-bottom:24px}
.tag{border:1px solid #7a4118;border-radius:30px;padding:8px 12px;color:#f1cc62;font-size:11px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#330b11,#19060a);transition:.25s}
.tag:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 0 18px #e8b83e35;border-color:var(--gold)}
.magic-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;padding:15px;border:1px solid #6c431a;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#27090f,#120509);transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s}
.magic-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--gold)}
.magic-icon{width:43px;height:43px;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:21px;color:var(--gold);flex-shrink:0}
.magic-text{flex:1}.magic-text strong{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#fff0c8}.magic-text small{display:block;color:#b9a36c;font-size:11px;margin-top:4px}
button{font:700 11px 'Cinzel',serif;letter-spacing:.5px;color:#26080d;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#f6cf59,#b97719);border:1px solid #f4c54e;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}
button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 0 22px #e8b83e55}
.music{border:1px solid #694313;border-radius:23px;padding:22px 23px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#1b060b,#100307);align-self:start;margin-top:2px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 25px #6e24100b}
.music-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid #3b1d16;padding-bottom:15px;color:#d7b957;font:600 11px 'Cinzel',serif;letter-spacing:1px}
.track{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin:18px 0}
.album{width:82px;height:82px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #98731d;background:conic-gradient(#0d5c94,#18b6ac,#3b0b76,#f3c82d,#123d78,#0d5c94);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 0 18px #079dc533;flex-shrink:0}
.album span{font-size:29px;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 5px #000)}
.track h3{font:700 17px 'Playfair Display',serif;margin:0 0 5px;color:#fff0cf}
.track p{font-size:12px;color:#ad955f;margin:0;line-height:1.5}
.progress{width:100%;height:5px;border-radius:9px;background:#382128;margin:15px 0 7px;overflow:hidden}
.progress span{display:block;width:0;height:100%;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#d88c1c,#ffdf68);transition:width .4s}
.times{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:10px 'Cinzel',serif;color:#9f8855}
.controls{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:24px;margin:17px 0 18px}
.controls button{padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:#d6b858;font-size:18px;box-shadow:none}
.controls .play{width:48px;height:48px;border:1px solid #f0bc39;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f5cf59,#9c4d09);color:#26080d;font-size:18px}
.playlist{border-top:1px solid #3b1d16;padding-top:14px}
.playlist summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;color:#d2b653;font:600 11px 'Cinzel',serif;letter-spacing:.6px}
.playlist summary:before{content:"▸ ";color:var(--gold)}
.playlist[open] summary:before{content:"▾ "}
.songs{padding-top:10px;display:grid;gap:7px}
.song{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:11px;color:#c7b58a;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}
.song:hover,.song.active{background:#3a1017;color:#ffdc69}
.song small{color:#917747;white-space:nowrap}
.footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:15px 24px;border-top:1px solid #493019;color:#8e7847;font:11px 'Cinzel',serif}
.footer span:last-child{color:#d2ad4c}
.sparkle{position:fixed;z-index:99;pointer-events:none;font-size:13px;color:#ffe78a;text-shadow:0 0 10px #ffc83d;animation:sparkleOut .75s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes sparkleOut{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(0,8px) scale(.4) rotate(0)}25%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(var(--dx),-30px) scale(1.3) rotate(90deg)}}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:25px;transform:translate(-50%,20px);padding:12px 18px;border:1px solid #b8842c;border-radius:30px;background:#21070d;color:#ffe8a3;font:12px 'Cinzel',serif;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s;z-index:100;box-shadow:0 5px 30px #0008}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media(max-width:760px){.wrap{margin:10px auto;width:calc(100% - 16px);border-radius:16px}.topbar{padding:0 14px}.hero{padding:32px 20px;min-height:230px}.hero-copy{text-align:center}.hero:before{left:12px;top:8px;font-size:75px}.content{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:26px 18px;gap:23px}.profile-head{margin-top:-66px;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end}.avatar{width:112px;height:112px}.online{font-size:10px}.music{margin-top:0}.footer{padding:14px 17px}.quote{font-size:24px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

/* Extras da Sih: mural de amigos + Patrono */
.friends{margin-top:24px;padding:18px;border:1px solid #6c431a;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#20070d,#100307)}
.section-title{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin:0 0 14px;color:#e8c45b;font:700 13px 'Cinzel',serif;letter-spacing:1px}
.section-title small{font:10px 'DM Sans',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.3px;color:#a58b55}
.friend-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.friend{min-width:0;text-align:center;padding:12px 5px 10px;border:1px solid #573018;border-radius:12px;background:#160509;transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s;cursor:pointer}
.friend:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:#f0c84d;box-shadow:0 0 22px #e8b83e35}
.friend-avatar{width:54px;height:54px;margin:0 auto 8px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:2px solid #d6a936;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%,#7e3039,#260811 75%);font-size:27px;box-shadow:0 0 13px #e8b83e1c}
.friend strong{display:block;font:600 11px 'Cinzel',serif;color:#ffedc2;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.friend small{display:block;margin-top:5px;font-size:10px;color:#b79c62}
.friend-note{margin:13px 0 0;color:#c8b68b;font:italic 12px/1.6 'Playfair Display',serif;text-align:center}
.patronus{margin-top:18px;padding:17px;border:1px solid #9a7427;border-radius:16px;display:flex;gap:15px;align-items:center;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 50%,#4b391d 0,#21100e 42%,#120509 100%);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.patronus:after{content:"✦  ✧  ⋆  ✧  ✦";position:absolute;right:10px;top:8px;color:#f7dc7c;opacity:.4;letter-spacing:7px;font-size:11px}
.stag{width:76px;height:76px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:43px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#d6f4ff55,#a6d8ff08 68%);border:1px solid #b9dcf2;box-shadow:0 0 24px #a8dfff44}
.patronus h3{margin:0 0 6px;font:700 14px 'Cinzel',serif;color:#e7d28b}
.patronus p{margin:0;color:#d4c6a6;font:italic 13px/1.55 'Playfair Display',serif}
.lumos-mode:before{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,#a64c35 0%,#68252d 35%,#2d0b15 75%,#13050a 100%)}
.lumos-mode .wrap{box-shadow:0 20px 90px #0008,0 0 50px #ffd96880,0 0 120px #e8b83e50;border-color:#ffe88b}
.lumos-mode .hero{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a84338ed,#7d252beF 48%,#42111af5),radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 80%,#ffd77a 0,transparent 55%)}
.lumos-mode .avatar{box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #4c171b,0 0 48px #ffe66eaa}
.lumos-mode .music,.lumos-mode .magic-card,.lumos-mode .friends{border-color:#e7c85e;box-shadow:0 0 28px #e8b83e30,inset 0 0 25px #e8b83e0c}
.lumos-mode .star{width:4px;height:4px;box-shadow:0 0 16px 5px #ffe88b;animation-duration:1.3s!important}
.lumos-mode .patronus{box-shadow:0 0 35px #bceaff55;border-color:#d6f0ff}
.lumos-mode .stag{box-shadow:0 0 40px #b6eaffbb;background:radial-gradient(circle,#e5faff99,#8bd5ff16 70%)}
@media(max-width:760px){.friend-grid{gap:7px}.friend{padding:10px 3px}.friend-avatar{width:48px;height:48px}.patronus{align-items:flex-start}.stag{width:62px;height:62px;font-size:35px}}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="ambient" id="stars"></div>
<main class="wrap">
  <nav class="topbar"><div><span class="brand">XAT.ME</span> <span style="color:#6f5730">|</span> SIH'S SPACE</div><div class="house">♜ GRIFINÓRIA</div></nav>
  <header class="hero">
    <div class="hero-copy">
      <div class="eyebrow">Hogwarts · Grifinória</div>
      <p class="quote">“As palavras são, na sua não dispensável fonte, a nossa mais inesgotável fonte de magia.”</p>
      <div class="quote-author">— Alvo Dumbledore</div>
    </div>
  </header>
  <section class="content">
    <div class="profile">
      <div class="profile-head">
        <div class="avatar"><div class="avatar-inner" style="background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:center 34%;"><span style="font-size:0">Sih</span></div></div>
        <div class="online"><i></i> Na Sala Comunal da Grifinória</div>
      </div>
      <p class="welcome">Bem-vinda ao meu cantinho</p>
      <h1>Sih <span class="crown">♛</span></h1>
      <div class="handle">✦ GRIFINÓRIA · SIH ✦</div>
      <p class="bio">“Coragem na alma, fogo no coração e uma boa música para embalar cada feitiço.”</p>
      <div class="tags"><span class="tag">✦ magia viva</span><span class="tag">♫ daniel caesar & R&amp;B</span><span class="tag">♜ grifinória</span><span class="tag">☾ doce caos</span></div>
      <div class="magic-card">
        <div class="magic-icon">✧</div>
        <div class="magic-text"><strong>Feitiço do momento</strong><small id="spell">“Lumos Maxima” · brilho próprio</small></div>
        <button id="lumos">Lumos ✨</button>
      </div>

      <section class="friends">
        <h2 class="section-title"><span>♡ MEU CÍRCULO MÁGICO</span><small>estilo Orkut · pessoas especiais</small></h2>
        <div class="friend-grid">
          <div class="friend" tabindex="0" data-note="Luna · meu pedacinho de coragem, amor e luz."><div class="friend-avatar">🌙</div><strong>Luna</strong><small>Minha estrelinha ♡</small></div>
          <div class="friend" tabindex="0" data-note="Kiara · meu abraço favorito e uma das magias mais bonitas da minha vida."><div class="friend-avatar">🦋</div><strong>Kiara</strong><small>Minha pequena magia ♡</small></div>
          <div class="friend" tabindex="0" data-note="Theuz · amizade que deixa a caminhada mais leve e divertida."><div class="friend-avatar">⚡</div><strong>Theuz</strong><small>Amigo mágico ✦</small></div>
        </div>
        <p class="friend-note" id="friendNote">“Algumas pessoas são estrelas: deixam tudo mais bonito só por existirem.”</p>
      </section>
      <section class="patronus">
        <div class="stag">🦌</div>
        <div><h3>Meu Patrono · O Cervo</h3><p>“Que o amor seja meu feitiço mais forte, a esperança meu caminho e a magia a luz que nunca se apaga.”</p></div>
      </section>
    </div>
    <aside class="music">
      <div class="music-head"><span>♫ &nbsp; NO MEU FONE</span><span id="trackNo">01 / 03</span></div>
      <div class="track"><div class="album"><span>✦</span></div><div><h3 id="songTitle">See You Again</h3><p id="songArtist">Kali Uchis (feat. Tyler, The Creator)</p></div></div>
      <div class="progress"><span id="bar"></span></div>
      <div class="times"><span id="elapsed">0:00</span><span id="duration">4:38</span></div>
      <div class="controls"><button id="prev" aria-label="Faixa anterior">|◀</button><button class="play" id="toggle" aria-label="Tocar ou pausar">▶</button><button id="next" aria-label="Próxima faixa">▶|</button><button id="volume" aria-label="Som">♫</button></div>
      <details class="playlist" open>
        <summary>MINHA PLAYLIST <span style="float:right;color:#927947">3 faixas</span></summary>
        <div class="songs" id="songs">
          <div class="song active" data-index="0"><span>See You Again</span><small>Kali Uchis</small></div>
          <div class="song" data-index="1"><span>Best Part</span><small>Daniel Caesar</small></div>
          <div class="song" data-index="2"><span>telepatía</span><small>Kali Uchis</small></div>
        </div>
      </details>
    </aside>
  </section>
  <footer class="footer"><span>© xat.me · Sih's Space</span><span>“MALFEITO FEITO!” ♜</span></footer>
</main>
<div class="toast" id="toast">✨ Lumos! Que a magia comece ✨</div>
<script>
const starField=document.getElementById('stars');
for(let i=0;i<45;i++){const s=document.createElement('i');s.className='star';s.style.left=Math.random()*100+'%';s.style.top=Math.random()*100+'%';s.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*4)+'s';s.style.animationDuration=(2+Math.random()*4)+'s';s.style.opacity=Math.random()*.7+.1;starField.appendChild(s)}
let lastSparkle=0;
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const now=Date.now();if(now-lastSparkle<55)return;lastSparkle=now;const el=document.createElement('span');el.className='sparkle';el.textContent=['✦','✧','⋆','✴'][Math.floor(Math.random()*4)];el.style.left=e.clientX+'px';el.style.top=e.clientY+'px';el.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*36-18)+'px');document.body.appendChild(el);setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),800)});
const toast=document.getElementById('toast');let toastTimer;
function showToast(msg){toast.textContent=msg;toast.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('show'),2200)}
document.getElementById('lumos').addEventListener('click',()=>{const active=document.body.classList.toggle('lumos-mode');document.body.style.setProperty('--gold',active?'#ffe36b':'#e8b83e');document.getElementById('spell').textContent=active?'“Lumos Maxima” · magia no máximo!':'“Lumos Maxima” · brilho próprio';document.getElementById('lumos').textContent=active?'Nox 🌙':'Lumos ✨';showToast(active?'✨ LUMOS MAXIMA! A magia iluminou tudo ✨':'🌙 Nox! A luz repousa por enquanto');for(let i=0;i<16;i++){setTimeout(()=>{const s=document.createElement('span');s.className='sparkle';s.textContent='✦';s.style.left=(innerWidth*.25+Math.random()*innerWidth*.5)+'px';s.style.top=(innerHeight*.2+Math.random()*innerHeight*.6)+'px';s.style.fontSize=(12+Math.random()*18)+'px';s.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*80-40)+'px');document.body.appendChild(s);setTimeout(()=>s.remove(),800)},i*35)}});
const tracks=[{title:'See You Again',artist:'Kali Uchis (feat. Tyler, The Creator)',duration:'4:38',seconds:278},{title:'Best Part',artist:'Daniel Caesar feat. H.E.R.',duration:'3:29',seconds:209},{title:'telepatía',artist:'Kali Uchis',duration:'2:40',seconds:160}];
let current=0,playing=false,seconds=0,tick=null;
const title=document.getElementById('songTitle'),artist=document.getElementById('songArtist'),duration=document.getElementById('duration'),elapsed=document.getElementById('elapsed'),bar=document.getElementById('bar'),toggle=document.getElementById('toggle');
function fmt(n){return Math.floor(n/60)+':'+String(n%60).padStart(2,'0')}
function renderTrack(){const t=tracks[current];title.textContent=t.title;artist.textContent=t.artist;duration.textContent=t.duration;document.getElementById('trackNo').textContent=String(current+1).padStart(2,'0')+' / 03';seconds=0;elapsed.textContent='0:00';bar.style.width='0%';document.querySelectorAll('.song').forEach((s,i)=>s.classList.toggle('active',i===current))}
function pause(){playing=false;toggle.textContent='▶';if(tick)clearInterval(tick);tick=null}
function play(){playing=true;toggle.textContent='Ⅱ';if(tick)clearInterval(tick);tick=setInterval(()=>{seconds++;elapsed.textContent=fmt(seconds);bar.style.width=(seconds/tracks[current].seconds*100)+'%';if(seconds>=tracks[current].seconds){current=(current+1)%tracks.length;renderTrack()}},1000);showToast('♫ Modo playlist ativado');}
toggle.addEventListener('click',()=>playing?pause():play());
document.getElementById('next').addEventListener('click',()=>{current=(current+1)%tracks.length;renderTrack();if(playing)play()});
document.getElementById('prev').addEventListener('click',()=>{current=(current+tracks.length-1)%tracks.length;renderTrack();if(playing)play()});
document.getElementById('volume').addEventListener('click',()=>showToast('♫ Adicione seu player de música favorito aqui'));
document.querySelectorAll('.song').forEach(s=>s.addEventListener('click',()=>{current=Number(s.dataset.index);renderTrack();if(playing)play()}));

document.querySelectorAll('.friend').forEach(friend=>{
  const activate=()=>{document.getElementById('friendNote').textContent=friend.dataset.note;showToast('♡ Um carinho para '+friend.querySelector('strong').textContent+' ♡')};
  friend.addEventListener('click',activate);
  friend.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();activate()}});
});

</script>
</body>
</html>
